variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 9.6x53mm
variants.info:
Load your SVU with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A much large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.
